3. The plaintiffs' case, in short, is that defendant No.1 while was the owner of the lands described in the schedule to the plaint as property No.1 measuring 3.26 acres to plaintiff No.1 vide Settlement Case No.223 of 1954-1955 on receiving salami on 13-6-1958 and also receiving rent for it and accordingly, made delivery of possession. Following the said settlement, Khas Mohol Khatian No.1244 and holding No.1134 were opened in the name of plaintiff No.1. Accordingly; the land was also recorded in his name in SA Khatian No.471, and during the Diara survey, it was recorded in his name in Diara Khatian No.506. He has his homestead along with the dwelling house in the said property No.1. The land of property No.1 described in the schedule to the plaint measuring 2.50 acres was also settled by defendant No.1-Government to Hamid Ullah vide Settlement Case No.1068 of 1959-1960. On receiving salami and delivering possession of the same in his favour, Khas Mohol Khatian No.1271 and holding No.1162 were also opened in his name and accordingly, his name was also recorded in Diara Khatian No.545. Subsequently, Hamid Ullah sold the said land to Rafiqunnessa vide registered kabala dated 19-9-1968. Accordingly, Rafiqunnessa got her name mutated vide Mutation Case No.982 of 1973-1974. Then, she sold her land to plaintiff Nos.2-5 vide registered kabala dated 15-6-1977. Accordingly, plaintiff Nos.2-5 got their names mutated vide Mutation Case No.604 of 1978-1979, paid rent to the Government and they have been possessing their land by cultivation. The further case of the plaintiffs is that Abdul Awal got a settlement of 2.45 acres of land described as property No.3 in the schedule to the plaint. Accordingly, he paid salami, got possession and also paid rent. Subsequently, Abdul Awal sold his property to Abul Kashem, who subsequently sold the same to plaintiff No.6. Then, plaintiff No.6 sold 1.08 acres to one Abdul Awal, who purchased it in the benami of his son Abdur Rob, defendant No.4. Then, Abdul Awal sold his purchased land to plaintiff No.7 vide registered kabala dated 24-5-1976. The said land was recorded in the names of plaintiff Nos.6 and 7 in Diara Khatian No.255. Thus, plaintiff Nos.6 and 7 are owners of said property No.3. Plaintiff No.6 has his dwelling homestead in Diara Plot No.326 of the said land. Subsequently, plaintiff No.6 mortgaged the said land to Krishi Bank, Maijdee Court Branch and got a loan in 1978. Plaintiff No.7 also constructed a homestead on his portion. Thus, the plaintiffs are owners-in-possession of the land described in the schedule to the plaintiff. But the plaintiffs got a notice on 06-9- 1979 from defendant No.2 through the then-local Circle Officer regarding some of the lands of the plaintiffs. In the said notice, it was alleged that SA Miscellaneous Case No.39 of 1979-1980 was started against the plaintiffs for recovery of the same as the land of the police department .:rider the provision of Ordinance No.XXII of 1970. The plaintiffs filed an objection thereto stating their claim on the land, but the plaintiffs' lawyer was not allowed to peruse the records of the said case. Subsequently, two local police constables threatened the plaintiffs on 15-9-1979 to vacate the said land to the police department otherwise, they would be sent to jail while the defendants have no right, title or possession in the suit land. The plaintiffs are owners-in-possession of the suit land. Accordingly, the plaintiffs filed the instant suit. 

 4. Defendant Nos.1 and 2 contested the suit by filing a written statement. It was stated in the written statement that the suit land was acquired for the police department and educational department. The suit land is khas land of the Government. The suit land was acquired vide LA Case No.4 of 1908-1909 and accordingly, it was duly recorded in the name of the school in DS Khatian No.1186. The suit land was diluviated and alluviated land. The suit land was never settled for the plaintiffs. Khatian No.506 in the name of the plaintiff is false, Lands of DS Khatian No.1177/1 were acquired for the police department vide LA Miscellaneous Case No.2 of 1971-1972. Khatian No.545 in the name of the plaintiffs is also false. Lands of DS Khatian No.1177/1 was also acquired for the jail department vide LA Miscellaneous Case No.3 of 1981. Thus, the Diara Khatian in the names of the plaintiffs is fraudulent. SA Miscellaneous Case No.39 of 1979-1980 was started for the suit land. Accordingly, the plaintiffs have no right, title or possession in the suit land and hence, the suit is liable to be dismissed. 

 14. There is no dispute that the suit land originally belonged to the Government. But as per the plaintiffs' case, they got the suit land vide three Settlement Cases, Settlement Case Nos.223 of 1954-1955, 1068 of 1959-1960 and 892 of 1959-1960. Accordingly, following the said three Settlement Cases, Khas Mohol Khatian Nos.1244, 1271 and 5822 were opened and accordingly, they paid salami and rent and similarly, a separate holding of the land was also opened in the name of the said settlement receivers. The plaintiffs are claiming the suit land either by way of inheritance or by purchase from the settlement receivers and after such settlement or purchase, they have been possessing the respective lands by constructing homesteads, including the dwellinghouse or by cultivation.
